_comment: Giai đoạn 3 (i18n) — bảng dịch error_code sang tiếng Anh. CHỈ dịch nhóm ưu tiên (auth/token/account) theo plan_language_polish.md A.2 Giai đoạn 3.2 — error_code KHÔNG có ở đây sẽ tự fallback về message tiếng Việt gốc từ backend (xem resolveErrorMessage() trong src/lib/api/client.ts), không bao giờ vỡ UI. Không đưa vào đây các error_code có nội dung động (số lần thử, tên field...) vì message thật đã được backend chèn giá trị runtime vào — dịch tĩnh sẽ làm mất thông tin đó; nhóm này để dịch sau khi có cơ chế template biến số.
token_expired: Access token is invalid or has expired — use the refresh token via POST /auth/refresh to get a new one.
session_revoked: This session is no longer valid — please log in again.
session_replaced: This account just logged in from another location — the current session has been logged out. Each account can only be used in one place at a time.
auth_server_chua_cau_hinh_api: The server is not configured with an API_KEY — see .env.example.
auth_missing: Missing or invalid API key. Send it via the 'X-API-Key' header.
auth_email_not_verified: Email not verified yet — check your inbox or call POST /auth/resend-verification to resend the verification link.
auth_locked: Account temporarily locked due to too many consecutive failed logins — please try again in a few minutes.
auth_refresh_token_thu_hoi_truoc: This refresh token has already been revoked — for security, all sessions for this account have been logged out. Please log in again.
auth_expired_2: Refresh token has expired — please log in again.
auth_deactivated_2: This account is no longer active.
auth_email_tai_khoan: This email already has an account.
auth_invalid: The password reset link is invalid or has already been used.
auth_expired: The password reset link has expired — call POST /auth/forgot-password again to get a new one.
user_email_tai_khoan: This email already has an account.
user_role_1_user_ss_team: Role must be one of: user, ss_team, admin.
user_forbidden: You can't change your own role — ask another admin to do this.
user_forbidden_2: You can't deactivate/activate your own account — ask another admin to do this.
